evals.prompt: is langgraph production-ready for an internal analyst workflow? need github evidence, docs, releases, issues, license
evals.expected_output: A cited Markdown report. Every high-impact claim carries an evidence id that resolves to a logged evidence row, with a locator, a freshness label and an uncertainty label. The report names at least one contradicting or unclear finding, and states the effort tier and source classes used.
assertions: A Markdown report file exists and is non-empty
Every [E####] citation in the report resolves to a row in evidence_ledger.csv
The report contains at least one evidence row whose stance is contradicts or unclear
The report's method appendix states the effort tier and the source classes searched
The report contains no unresolved {placeholder} text

evals.prompt: Research whether LangChain open_deep_research is production-ready for an internal analyst workflow. Include GitHub evidence, docs, releases, issues, license, and alternatives.
evals.expected_output: A cited report that inspects the repository beyond its README: the source, the tests, the releases, the open issues, and the licence file, each with a locator. Maintenance risk and the unresolved issues are named, and every high-impact claim cites an evidence id.
assertions: A Markdown report file exists and is non-empty
The report has an Executive summary section and a Method appendix section
The report cites at least three distinct evidence ids
At least one evidence row has source_type of source-code, release-note, or official-doc
The report contains no unresolved {placeholder} text

evals.prompt: Write a literature review of Self-RAG, IRCoT, ReAct, STORM, and GraphRAG for building a research agent. Include papers, code/data, limitations, and open questions.
evals.expected_output: A literature review with a literature map grouping the papers by idea, the paper route covered (arXiv or venue pages), the limitations each paper states, the follow-up graph, and the open questions the literature leaves unresolved.
assertions: A Markdown report file exists and is non-empty
The report names all five papers by title
The report has a Literature map section or a table of papers
At least one evidence row has source_type of paper or preprint
The report contains no unresolved {placeholder} text

assertions: A Markdown report file exists and is non-empty

The report contains at least one evidence row whose stance is contradicts or unclear

The report contains no unresolved {placeholder} text
